<p align="center">
  <strong>eD2K &middot; Kad &middot; Rust</strong><br />

## Maintenance and references

eMuleBB Rust is the active product-development lane. The MFC client remains the stable Windows diagnostic baseline and may receive critical fixes and bounded, low-risk maintenance.

- [Stable maintenance downloads](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb/releases/tag/emulebb-v0.7.3): Version 0.7.3 remains published while the 0.7.x line provides diagnostics, critical fixes, and bounded maintenance.

<details>
<summary>Test infrastructure and compatibility references</summary>

- [`emulebb`](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb): Stable 0.7.x Windows client, diagnostic baseline, and critical-fix maintenance lane.
- [`ed2k-server`](https://github.com/emulebb/ed2k-server): Sole local deterministic eD2K server, maintained as a minimal upstream-aligned Rust fork.
- [aMule upstream](https://github.com/amule-org/amule) (`master`): Actively developed upstream client used for analysis and future interoperability.
- [eMule stock 0.72](https://github.com/irwir/eMule) (`v0.72a`): Stock compatibility baseline for protocol and state-machine parity.

</details>
